steps.title: Setup Android Project
steps.description: Initialize a new Android project with the specified package and app name. Configure the build.gradle files for the correct SDK versions and Java compatibility.

steps.title: Define Application Theme and Strings
steps.description: Set up the basic UI theme using Theme.Material.Light and define app-specific strings.

steps.title: Create Splash Screen Layout and Activity
steps.description: Implement a splash screen to initialize the application and read 'app_id' from assets/app-meta.json.

steps.title: Implement Backend API Client
steps.description: Develop a generic Java class for interacting with the TrumpleDroid backend API, handling authentication and CRUD operations. Ensure app_id and token handling are correct.

steps.title: Create Student Data Model
steps.description: Define a simple Java POJO to represent student data, matching the 'students' collection in api_schema.json.

steps.title: Develop Registration UI and Logic
steps.description: Redesign the user interface for new user registration with improved aesthetics and implement the logic to register users with the backend.

steps.title: Develop Login UI and Logic
steps.description: Redesign the user interface for user login with improved aesthetics and implement the logic to authenticate users and store the authentication token.

steps.title: Design Custom Student List Item Layout
steps.description: Create a new XML layout file for individual student items in the list to provide a richer, more engaging visual presentation.

steps.title: Create Custom Student List Adapter
steps.description: Develop a custom ListView adapter that utilizes the new 'list_item_student.xml' layout to efficiently display student data with enhanced styling in the main activity.

steps.title: Implement Main Student List UI
steps.description: Redesign the main activity layout to display a list of students with the new custom list items and provide options to add new students or log out with enhanced button styles.

steps.title: Implement Main Activity Logic
steps.description: Add logic to MainActivity to fetch and display student data from the backend, handle student selection for editing, and manage the logout process.

steps.title: Design Student Detail/CRUD UI
steps.description: Redesign a dedicated activity layout for adding new student records or editing existing ones, including fields for name, roll number, grade, and email, along with save and delete buttons, all with improved visual styling.

steps.title: Implement Student Detail/CRUD Logic
steps.description: Develop the logic for the StudentDetailActivity to handle creating, updating, and deleting student records via the BackendApi, and managing navigation.

steps.title: Refine User Experience
steps.description: Ensure smooth navigation between activities, clear feedback to the user on API operations (e.g., success/error messages), and proper session management. Implement consistent styling across the application.

steps.title: Building StudentManager
steps.description: Compile and run the Android application. Test all features: user registration, login, logout, adding a new student, viewing the student list, editing a student, and deleting a student, observing the new UI design.
